entry.name: Alert
entry.description_fallback: Contextual feedback message with intent colors, optional title, dismiss button and icon slots.

notes.noteFallback: Alerts with status "warning" or "error" use role="alert" with aria-live="assertive". Other statuses use role="status" with aria-live="polite".
The close button receives an aria-label from the closeLabel prop, defaulting to the translated "Close" string via the locale system.
The component tracks hover state via @mouseenter/@mouseleave and propagates it via update:hover. Focus visible styles are applied for keyboard navigation.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus to the close button when closable=true.
Activates the close button when focused.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Background for the success status variant.
Background for the warning status variant.
Background for the danger/error status variant.
Font size of the title area.

legend.descriptionFallback: Root element. CSS grid with 4 columns: prepend / content / append / close. role="alert" (assertive) for warning/error, role="status" (polite) for info/success.
Leading area (grid-area: prepend). Renders prependIcon or prependAvatar, or the #prepend slot.
Content container (grid-area: content). Holds the header (__header) and body (__body).
Header area inside content. Contains the icon and/or title. Rendered only when hasHeader is true.
Body area. Contains the #text slot or text prop, plus the #default slot.
Close button area (grid-area: close). Rendered only when closable=true or the #close slot is used.
Absolute decorative layer. grid-area: none; position: absolute. Used for the colored border-radius adaptation in the inset border modifier.

classes.descriptionFallback: Root grid container. role="alert" or "status" based on intent.
Absolute decorative underlay layer.
Leading icon/avatar zone.
Main content column.
Header row inside content (icon + title).
Title text element inside the header.
Body text zone.
Trailing icon/avatar zone (grid-area: append).
Close button container (grid-area: close).

entry.name: App
entry.description_fallback: Application shell root. Thin wrapper over OrigamLayout that sets the page background and default text colour; all descendant components inherit the colour cascade.

notes.noteFallback: App is a structural shell — it does not carry an ARIA role itself. Place semantic landmarks (<header>, <main>, <nav>, <footer>) inside the default slot.
The color prop sets the root text colour via CSS inheritance. Ensure sufficient contrast between the chosen color and bgColor values.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus through interactive children inside the app shell.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Default app background. References the semantic surface default.
Root text colour inherited by all descendants.
Minimum viewport height for the shell.
Always flex so the layout renders as a column.

entry.name: AppBar
entry.description_fallback: Sticky top-of-page header that integrates with the layout engine. Supports scroll-driven behaviours (hide, collapse, elevate, active) and forwards all Toolbar surface props.

notes.noteFallback: Default tag is <header>, which has the implicit role="banner" at document level. Provides the primary page navigation landmark.
All scroll-behaviour transitions (hide/show, collapse) respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus through interactive elements inside the bar (prepend icons, title link, append icons).

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Default bar height registered with the layout engine.

props.description_fallback: Deprecated. Use loopMode instead. Maps to loopMode="one" at runtime.

props.name: loopMode
props.description_fallback: Tri-state loop strategy: "none" stops after last track, "all" wraps playlist, "one" loops current track.

props.name: shuffle
props.description_fallback: Shuffle playlist order using Fisher-Yates. Has no effect without a playlist.

props.name: playlist

entry.name: Badge
entry.description_fallback: Overlay badge for notification counts, status dots and labels, anchored to a wrapped element.

notes.noteFallback: The badge pill has role="status" with aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true". Screen readers announce badge content changes (e.g. new count).
The label prop (or the translated "origam.badge" key) is used as aria-label to describe the badge to screen readers. Pass a meaningful value like "5 unread notifications".
In dot mode, the content is visually hidden (text-indent: -9999px) but the aria-label still conveys the status to screen readers.

entry.name: Blockquote
entry.description_fallback: Typographic citation component with five visual variants, author/source attribution and locale-aware decorative quote marks.

notes.noteFallback: The cite prop maps to the native cite attribute on the <blockquote>, providing the URL to assistive technologies and browser inspectors.
The decorative quote mark (<span class="origam-blockquote__mark">) is aria-hidden="true" — it is purely decorative and not announced by screen readers.
The em-dash before the author name (<span class="origam-blockquote__dash">) is also aria-hidden to avoid double reading.
The source label is wrapped in <cite> for semantic correctness per the HTML spec.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus through interactive content inside the citation body if any.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Background glyph size in quoted variant.

entry.name: Breadcrumb
entry.description_fallback: Hierarchical navigation trail rendered as a <nav> landmark with an ordered list of items and configurable dividers.

notes.noteFallback: The root <nav> receives aria-label="Breadcrumb" from the useLocale translation (key: origam.breadcrumb.ariaLabel).
The last item is automatically set to aria-current="page" via the isActive prop on OrigamBreadcrumbItem.
OrigamBreadcrumbDivider is aria-hidden — the separators are purely presentational and not read by screen readers.
The v-contrast directive is applied to the root for auto contrast when a custom color is set.
Disabled items receive opacity-50 and pointer-events: none without the native disabled attribute (which does not apply to anchors).

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus through each breadcrumb item link.
Follows the link of the focused breadcrumb item.

Append area: grid-area append. Hosts appendIcon, appendAvatar, or the append slot.

entry.name: BtnGroup
entry.description_fallback: Groups Btn elements into a connected segmented control. Propagates density, color and hover/active state to child buttons via OrigamDefaultsProvider.

entry.name: Calendar
entry.description_fallback: Full-featured calendar with month, week, day and agenda views, drag-select, event colouring by category and v-model bindings.

notes.noteFallback: role="application" is used on the root to indicate rich interactive content to assistive technologies. The @keydown handler manages arrow navigation.
Month view uses role="grid" / role="row" / role="gridcell" for full grid semantics. Week numbers use role="rowheader".
Each event button has an aria-label describing the event title and time range.
Disabled day cells receive aria-disabled="true". Drag-select is prevented on disabled cells.
Today's cell is identified visually with a primary background tint. Consumers should add aria-label="Today" via the #day slot for full AT support.

keyboard.actionFallback: Navigate between day cells in month view or seek in timeline views.
Move focus between toolbar controls and day cells.
Activate a focused day cell (fires date-click) or event button (fires event-click).

entry.name: Card
entry.description_fallback: Versatile surface container with title, subtitle, image asset, text body, footer slots, link support, loading states and ripple interaction.

notes.noteFallback: When disabled=true, tabindex="-1" is set to remove the card from the tab order.
When href or to is set, the card root renders as <a> with proper link semantics. The ripple v-ripple directive triggers on the native click event.
Focus-visible outline is applied via :focus-visible in the component SCSS — visible for keyboard navigation, not mouse clicks.
The __overlay and __underlay spans are aria-hidden (inert layers).
The v-contrast directive is applied to ensure accessible foreground/background contrast when color is set.
The OrigamProgress inside the loader slot has role="progressbar". OrigamSkeleton is aria-hidden (decorative).

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus to the card when it is interactive (link=true or href/to is set).
Activates the card link or click handler when focused.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Hover elevation shadow for interactive cards.

notes.noteFallback: The title prop is rendered as plain text in a <div>. If the card header serves as a section heading, wrap the title slot content in the appropriate heading element (<h2>, <h3>, etc.) for correct document outline.
When appendIcon is an action (e.g. a menu trigger), add aria-label via the #append slot or on the wrapping element to describe the action to screen reader users.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus to interactive elements inside the header (prepend/append clicks).

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Minimum height of the card header.
Horizontal padding of the card header.

entry.name: Carousel
entry.description_fallback: Sliding window component for cycling through a set of items, with pagination dots, optional progress bar, auto-play interval and keyboard navigation.

notes.noteFallback: Each pagination dot receives aria-label="Slide N of M" via useLocale t() — screen readers announce position.
Auto-play is suppressed when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is detected (prefersReducedMotion() check on mount).
The slide timer is cleared on unmount and restarted on modelValue change, but there is no explicit pause-on-focus — consider disabling cycle for keyboard-heavy contexts.

keyboard.actionFallback: Navigates to the previous or next slide when focused on the carousel.
Moves focus through pagination dots and navigation arrows.
Activates the focused pagination dot or arrow button.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Dot strip background. Transparent when hideDelimiterBackground=true.
Height of the pagination dot strip.
Icon opacity inside the active dot.

entry.name: Chart
entry.description_fallback: Universal chart component with 29 visualization primitives (line, area, bar, column, pie, donut, scatter, radar, gauge, pyramid, funnel, honeycomb, treemap, sankey, word-cloud, heatmap, sunburst, box-plot, pictorial, candlestick, streamgraph, variwide, polar-bar, bullet, pareto, map, sparkline, spline, stepped-line). The type prop routes to the appropriate family member.

notes.noteFallback: The animated prop respects prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — set animated=false or let the component detect the system preference.

Use colorScheme to provide intent-based colours with sufficient contrast for all colour-vision deficiency profiles. Avoid relying solely on hue to distinguish series — use dashed/solid patterns or labels when possible.
The #empty slot provides a meaningful message when no data is available, ensuring screen reader users are not left with a silent chart container.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus to interactive data points (when keyboard navigation is enabled).
Fires point-click emit on a focused data point.

    <!-- outlier dots (v-if showOutliers) -->
    <circle class="origam-chart-box-plot__outlier" />
  </g>

props.description_fallback: Pre-resolved legend entries (series + index + colour + visibility). Comes from useChart().legend.value in the parent chart.

props.name: position
props.description_fallback: Anchor of the legend block. Drives flex-direction: 'top' | 'bottom' = row; 'left' | 'right' = column.

emits.description_fallback: Raw click on a legend entry. Pair with series-toggle to mutate state.
Fires after a click with the intended next visibility value (inverted from current). The parent is responsible for actually mutating series.visible.

slots.description_fallback: Replaces one legend entry entirely. Receives the series, its index and its current visibility.

examples.code:
<template>
  <origam-chart-legend
    :items="items"
    position="bottom"
    @series-toggle="onToggle"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const items = ref([
  { series: { name: 'Revenue', data: [], visible: true }, index: 0, color: '#7c3aed', visible: true },
  { series: { name: 'Costs',   data: [], visible: true }, index: 1, color: '#ef4444', visible: true }
])

const onToggle = (series, nextVisible) => {
  const entry = items.value.find((e) => e.series.name === series.name)
  if (entry) {
    entry.visible = nextVisible
    entry.series.visible = nextVisible
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <origam-chart-legend :items="items" position="right" />
</template>

entry.name: ChartMap
entry.description_fallback: World map chart with two rendering modes: choropleth (country shapes coloured by value gradient) and flight-routes (curved Bezier arcs between country centroid pairs). Built on a 1000 × 500 SVG Mercator projection.

notes.noteFallback: Root has role="figure" with aria-label from the title prop (falls back to "map chart").
The SVG carries role="img" with a <title> and <desc> listing mode-specific counts (N countries or N routes).
Choropleth: each data country has aria-label "name: value". Non-data countries carry just the code as label.
Flight-routes: each arc has aria-label "FROM to TO: value".
Entry animations are disabled via @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus through interactive countries (choropleth) or routes (flight-routes). Non-data countries have tabindex="-1" and are skipped.
Activates the focused country or route, firing the point-click emit.

  <template #label>

  </template>

entry.name: ClientOnly
entry.description_fallback: Wrapper that renders its default slot ONLY after hydration on the client. On the server a configurable placeholder element (or the #fallback slot) is rendered instead, preventing hydration mismatches for client-only content.

notes.noteFallback: The auto-generated placeholder element carries aria-hidden="true" so it is invisible to assistive technologies. Only provide a placeholder that is purely decorative (skeleton, shimmer).
If the #fallback slot contains meaningful content (e.g. "Loading chart…"), ensure it is visible to screen readers (do not add aria-hidden).

OrigamClientOnly prevents hydration mismatches for content that relies on browser APIs (window, document, canvas, WebGL). Use it for charts, maps, canvas-based components and anything that reads window dimensions on mount.

entry.name: Clipboard
entry.description_fallback: Chrome-less copy-to-clipboard wrapper. Owns the navigator.clipboard.writeText pipeline and an auto-resetting "copied" flag. The default trigger is a single icon button; replace it entirely via the default scoped slot.

notes.noteFallback: The default trigger carries a dynamic aria-label that changes from "Copy to clipboard" to "Value copied to clipboard" once copied. Sourced from useLocale for full i18n.
The feedback label has aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce the success state without interrupting the current reading.
When disabled=true the default trigger has the disabled HTML attribute; the copy() exposed method short-circuits immediately.
When using a custom #default slot, ensure your trigger element has an appropriate aria-label and keyboard handler (or use origam-btn which handles both).

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus to the default trigger button.
Triggers the copy action from the focused default trigger button.

entry.name: Code
entry.description_fallback: Shiki-powered syntax-highlighted code block with optional line numbers, line highlighting, copy button, filename header, compact pill mode and theme awareness. Supports 14 languages and honours the active Origam theme.

notes.noteFallback: Root element defaults to <figure> for W3C correctness. The code block is rendered inside <pre><code data-lang="..."> which gives screen readers proper semantic context.
The copy button aria-label and aria-live="polite" are set so screen readers announce "Copied" after a successful write without interrupting the current reading.
The prompt prefix (<span aria-hidden="true">) is decorative — it is never read aloud and is never included in the clipboard payload.
The scrollable code area is focusable via keyboard when content overflows, allowing keyboard users to scroll horizontally.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus to the copy button when copyable=true.
Triggers the copy action on the focused copy button.

Page Up sets value to 1 (fully bright). Page Down sets value to 0 (black).

<template>
  <origam-command-palette
    v-model="open"
    :commands="commands"
    placeholder="Type a command…"
    @select="onSelect"
  />
  <origam-btn text="Open palette (⌘K)" @click="open = true" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  const open = ref(false)
  const commands = [
    { id: 'new-file',      label: 'New file',  icon: 'mdi-file-plus-outline', perform: () => {} },
    { id: 'open-settings', label: 'Settings',  icon: 'mdi-cog-outline',       perform: () => {} },
    { id: 'logout',        label: 'Sign out',  icon: 'mdi-logout',            perform: () => {} }
  ]
  function onSelect(cmd) { open.value = false }
</script>

<template>
  <origam-command-palette
    v-model="open"
    :commands="results"
    :loading="fetching"
    @query="search"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  const open = ref(false)
  const results = ref([])
  const fetching = ref(false)
  async function search(q: string) {
    fetching.value = true
    results.value = await fetchCommands(q)
    fetching.value = false
  }
</script>

<template>
  <origam-command-palette v-model="open" :commands="commands" />
</template>

  import { ref } from 'vue'
  const open = ref(false)

</script>

entry.name: ContextualMenu
entry.description_fallback: Right-click context menu that opens at the cursor position. Wraps OrigamMenu with openOnContextMenu + target="cursor" + activator="cursor" preconfigured.

notes.noteFallback: The menu panel is positioned at the exact cursor coordinates of the right-click event via target="cursor". This matches the native browser context menu behaviour.
On open, focus moves to the first enabled menu item. On close (Escape), focus returns to the element that received the right-click.

keyboard.actionFallback: Closes the context menu and returns focus to the trigger element.
Navigate between menu items.
Activates the focused menu item.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Stack order of the menu panel (= 1000).
Maximum width of the content area.

entry.name: Counter
entry.description_fallback: Animated character-count badge that shows current/max values. Used internally by TextField, Textarea and similar inputs.

notes.noteFallback: OrigamCounter is a visual helper only. When embedded in a text field, the parent field should use aria-describedby pointing to the counter element so screen readers announce the character count.
For dynamic character-count announcements, add aria-live="polite" to the counter element or its parent container.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Text colour when field is active/focused.
Text colour when value exceeds max.

anatomy.code:
<!-- Wrapped in OrigamTransition for animated show/hide -->
<origam-transition :transition="transition">
  <component
    :is="tag"
    v-show="active"
    class="origam-counter"
    :class="{ 'origam-counter--error': value > max && !disabled }"
  >
    <!-- #default slot: { counter, max, value } -->
    <slot :counter="counter" :max="max" :value="value">
      {{ counter }}
    </slot>
  </component>
</origam-transition>

entry.name: DataList
entry.description_fallback: Semantic description list (<dl>) with two layout modes: avatar (icon + title/text stacked) and kv (key/value rows aligned side-by-side).

notes.noteFallback: Avatar mode renders a semantic <dl> with <dt> (term/title) and <dd> (definition/text) elements. This provides native screen-reader association between key and value without ARIA.
KV mode also uses <dl>/<dt>/<dd> structure, which is the recommended HTML pattern for key/value pairs. Do not use a <table> unless the data is truly tabular (multiple columns with a column header).

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Fixed width of the key column in kv mode.
Row bottom border colour in kv mode.

examples.code:
<template>
  <origam-data-table :headers="headers" :items="users" item-value="id" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  const headers = [
    { key: 'name',  title: 'Name',  sortable: true },
    { key: 'email', title: 'Email', sortable: true },
    { key: 'role',  title: 'Role'  }
  ]
  const users = [
    { id: 1, name: 'Alice',   email: 'alice@example.com',   role: 'Admin' },
    { id: 2, name: 'Bob',     email: 'bob@example.com',     role: 'User' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <origam-data-table
    :headers="headers"
    :items="serverItems"
    :loading="loading"
    :items-per-page="pageSize"
    :page="currentPage"
    @update:options="onOptionsChange"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  const serverItems = ref([])
  const loading = ref(false)
  const currentPage = ref(1)
  const pageSize = ref(10)

  async function onOptionsChange(opts) {
    loading.value = true
    serverItems.value = await fetchPage(opts)
    loading.value = false
  }
</script>

Optional action buttons row. Use for Cancel / OK confirmation pattern. Only rendered when the #actions slot is provided.

props.name: hideWeekdays
props.description_fallback: Hides the weekday label row (Mon, Tue…) above the day grid.

props.name: multiple
props.description_fallback: Enables multi-date selection. Pass a number to cap the maximum selectable dates.

props.name: range
props.description_fallback: Enables date-range selection mode. Shift-click selects the range; Ctrl/Cmd-click adds individual dates.

props.name: showWeek
props.description_fallback: Shows ISO week numbers in an extra column on the left of the grid.

props.name: transition
props.description_fallback: Enter transition when navigating forward through months.

props.name: reverseTransition
props.description_fallback: Enter transition when navigating backward through months.

props.name: month
props.description_fallback: Zero-based month index (0 = January, 11 = December) currently displayed.

props.name: year
props.description_fallback: Four-digit year currently displayed.

props.name: date
props.description_fallback: Array of currently selected dates. Passed down from the parent DatePicker model.

props.name: min
props.description_fallback: Minimum selectable date. Days before this value are rendered as disabled.

props.name: max
props.description_fallback: Maximum selectable date. Days after this value are rendered as disabled.

props.name: allowedDates
props.description_fallback: Allowlist of selectable dates. Pass an array or a predicate function — other days are disabled.

props.name: showAdjacentMonths
props.description_fallback: Shows days from the previous and next months in the first and last rows. Adjacent days are faded (opacity: 0.5).

props.name: weekdays
props.description_fallback: Array of day indices (0 = Sunday) that define the column order of the grid.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description_fallback: First day of the week (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday…). Defaults to the locale setting.

props.name: weeksInMonth
props.description_fallback: Strategy for row count: 'dynamic' adapts to the month (4–6 rows); 'static' always renders 6 rows.

props.name: color
props.description_fallback: Intent or custom colour used for the selected day button background.

slots.description_fallback: Custom day cell content. Slot props expose the click handler (props.onClick), the day descriptor (item: IDay) and its grid index.

<template>
  <origam-date-picker-month
    v-model:date="selectedDates"
    :month="currentMonth"
    :year="currentYear"
    color="primary"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  const selectedDates = ref([])
  const currentMonth = ref(new Date().getMonth())
  const currentYear = ref(new Date().getFullYear())
</script>

<template>
  <origam-date-picker-month
    v-model:date="range"
    :month="5"
    :year="2026"
    range
    color="primary"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  const range = ref([])
</script>

<template>
  <origam-date-picker-month :month="5" :year="2026">
    <template #days="{ item, props }">
      <origam-btn
        v-bind="props"
        :text="item.localized"
        :color="item.isToday ? 'warning' : undefined"
        icon
      />
    </template>
  </origam-date-picker-month>
</template>

entry.name: DefaultsProvider
entry.description_fallback: Structurally transparent context provider that injects a prop-defaults map into all descendant Origam components via useDefaults().

notes.noteFallback: OrigamDefaultsProvider has no visual rendering, no focusable element and no ARIA attributes. All a11y considerations belong to the descendant components it wraps.

exposed.name: filterProps
exposed.type: <T extends object>(props: T, exclude?: string[]) => Partial<T>
exposed.descriptionFallback: Utility to forward a filtered subset of props to a child component. Used by Origam's auto-forwarding pattern.

props.name: defaults
props.description_fallback: Map of default prop values keyed by "global" (all components in subtree) or by component name (e.g. "origam-btn": { color: "primary" }).

props.name: disabled
props.description_fallback: When true, parent defaults are passed through unchanged — useful to temporarily disable an outer DefaultsProvider without unmounting it.

props.name: reset
props.description_fallback: When set, parent defaults are NOT inherited; the subtree starts from this provider's defaults only. The value is opaque but useful for DevTools tracing.

props.name: root
props.description_fallback: Marks the provider as a root scope — equivalent to reset but communicates intent: this is the top of a defaults tree, not a mid-tree override.

props.name: scoped
props.description_fallback: When true, parent defaults are not merged in — the subtree only sees this provider's defaults. Same effect as reset but expressed declaratively.

slots.description_fallback: Subtree that will receive the injected defaults. The component renders only this slot — it has no visual chrome of its own.

examples.code:
<template>
  <origam-defaults-provider :defaults="{ global: { density: 'comfortable' } }">
    <origam-btn text="Comfortable Btn" />
    <origam-chip text="Comfortable Chip" />
  </origam-defaults-provider>
</template>

<template>
  <origam-defaults-provider
    :defaults="{
      'origam-btn':  { color: 'primary', variant: 'tonal' },
      'origam-chip': { variant: 'outlined' }
    }"
  >
    <origam-btn text="Auto-primary tonal" />
    <origam-chip text="Auto-outlined" />
  </origam-defaults-provider>
</template>

<template>
  <!-- Outer provider sets density=compact globally -->
  <origam-defaults-provider :defaults="{ global: { density: 'compact' } }">
    <!-- Inner scoped provider: subtree only sees its own defaults, not compact -->
    <origam-defaults-provider
      :defaults="{ 'origam-btn': { color: 'success' } }"
      scoped
    >
      <origam-btn text="Success, not compact" />
    </origam-defaults-provider>
  </origam-defaults-provider>
</template>

relations.description_fallback: Often used together with DefaultsProvider to apply shared field density or variant across form fields.

<origam-overlay v-model="isActive" class="origam-dialog">
  <!-- activator trigger element -->
  <template #activator="{ props }">
    <slot name="activator" v-bind="{ props }" />
  </template>

  <template #default="{ isActive }">
    <slot name="default" v-bind="{ isActive }">
      <!-- default body: OrigamCard -->
      <origam-card
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        :aria-labelledby="dialogTitleId"
      >
        <!-- header zone: prepend | title | subtitle | append(close) -->
        <template #header-prepend><slot name="header-prepend" /></template>
        <template #header-title="{ titleId }"><slot name="header-title" v-bind="{ titleId }" /></template>
        <template #header-append>
          <slot name="header-append">
            <origam-btn icon="mdi-close" @click="handleClose" aria-label="Close dialog" />
          </slot>
        </template>

        <!-- scrollable content body -->
        <template #default>
          <slot name="content" />
          <div ref="endText" v-intersect="handleIntersect" />
        </template>

        <!-- footer actions -->
        <template #footer><slot name="footer" /></template>
      </origam-card>
    </slot>
  </template>
</origam-overlay>

anatomy.svgDesc: Schematic of the EmptyState component with 5 numbered internal parts.
anatomy.figcaption: Anatomy of <origam-empty-state> — 5 internal parts. The root ① carries role="status" and aria-live="polite"; each section is conditionally rendered.

cssVars.name: --origam-empty-state---padding-block
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Block padding of the root element. Per-size variants override this value.

cssVars.name: --origam-empty-state---padding-inline
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Inline padding of the root element.

cssVars.name: --origam-empty-state---gap
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Flex gap between icon, title, description and actions. Per-size overrides apply.

cssVars.name: --origam-empty-state---max-width
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Maximum width of the description text for readable line length.

cssVars.name: --origam-empty-state__icon---size
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Icon font-size / size. Overridden per size class (sm=48px, md=64px, lg=96px).

cssVars.name: --origam-empty-state__icon---color
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Icon colour. Overridden per intent modifier class (e.g. --intent-danger maps to danger feedback colour).

cssVars.name: --origam-empty-state__title---font-size
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Title font size. Overridden per size class.

cssVars.name: --origam-empty-state__description---font-size
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Description font size. Overridden per size class.

exposed.name: resolvedIcon
exposed.descriptionFallback: The resolved icon: user icon prop wins over preset default.

exposed.name: resolvedIntent
exposed.descriptionFallback: The resolved intent: user iconColor prop wins over preset default.

exposed.name: hasDefaultSlot
exposed.descriptionFallback: True when the default slot is provided — replaces the built-in layout entirely.

exposed.name: hasTitle
exposed.descriptionFallback: True when a title prop or #title slot is present.

exposed.name: hasDescription
exposed.descriptionFallback: True when a description prop or #description slot is present.

exposed.name: hasActions
exposed.descriptionFallback: True when the #actions slot is provided.

controls.defaultValue: Create your first item to get started.

props.name: preset
props.description_fallback: Visual preset. Bundles a default icon and intent. Values: 'no-data' | 'no-results' | 'error' | 'offline' | 'locked'. Override icon/iconColor to customise.

props.name: title
props.description_fallback: Primary heading rendered below the icon. Override with the #title slot for richer markup.

props.name: description
props.description_fallback: Optional sub-heading rendered below the title. Width is clamped by --origam-empty-state---max-width.

props.name: icon
props.description_fallback: Override the preset icon. Accepts an MDI string, a SVG path array, or a Vue component. Use the #icon slot for full SVG illustrations.

props.name: iconColor
props.description_fallback: Override the preset intent colour for the icon. Accepts semantic intent values (primary, success, danger…).

props.name: size
props.description_fallback: Vertical density. Values: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'. Drives icon size, font sizes, padding and gap.

props.name: align
props.description_fallback: Horizontal alignment of the icon / title / description / actions stack. Values: 'center' | 'left'.

props.name: tag
props.description_fallback: HTML element rendered at the root.

slots.description_fallback: Replaces the entire built-in layout (icon + title + description + actions). Use for fully bespoke placeholder markup.
Replaces the default OrigamIcon render. Use for SVG / illustrations. Mark as aria-hidden="true" when purely decorative.
Replaces the rendered title element. Slot wins over the title prop when both are provided.
Replaces the rendered description element. Slot wins over the description prop.
Actions row rendered below the description. Typically holds 1–2 buttons (Create, Retry, Sign in…).

examples.code:
<template>
  <origam-empty-state
    preset="no-data"
    title="No projects yet"
    description="Create your first project to get started."
  >
    <template #actions>
      <origam-btn color="primary" prepend-icon="mdi-plus" text="Create project" />
    </template>
  </origam-empty-state>
</template>

relations.description_fallback: Feature-rich data table that renders EmptyState when no rows exist.

entry.name: ExpandX
entry.description_fallback: JS-driven horizontal width expand/collapse transition. Animates the element width from 0 to its natural offsetWidth (enter) and back to 0 (leave). Duration 0.5s with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

notes.noteFallback: Set disabled=true to suppress all animations for users with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. OrigamDatePickerMonth passes this prop automatically when the media query matches.
ExpandX is transparent to the accessibility tree — it adds no ARIA roles or attributes. Only the slotted content is visible to screen readers.
During the transition, overflow: hidden is set on the element to prevent content from showing outside the animated bounds. The original overflow is restored in afterEnter / afterLeave.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Expand/collapse animation duration (shared with ExpandY). Slightly slower than fade/slide to account for layout reflow.
Easing curve for the expand animation.
Starting dimension for the expand animation (0 → offsetWidth).

anatomy.code:
<!-- OrigamExpandX — JS-driven <transition> -->
<transition
  name="origam-transition--expand-x"
  mode="in-out"
  :css="!disabled"
  @before-enter="handleBeforeEnter"
  @enter="handleEnter"
  @after-enter="handleAfterEnter"
  @enter-cancelled="handleEnterCancelled"
  @leave="handleLeave"
  @after-leave="handleAfterLeave"
  @leave-cancelled="handleLeaveCancelled"
>
  <slot name="default" />
</transition>

legend.descriptionFallback: Enter phase. CSS class drives transition-duration (0.5s), timing (cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)) and transition-property (width). The JS beforeEnter hook stashes the initial width; enter sets width to 0 then requestAnimationFrame restores offsetWidth.
Leave phase. CSS class drives transition-duration (0.5s), timing and transition-property. The JS leave hook stashes the current width and animates to 0. afterLeave restores the initial style.

classes.descriptionFallback: Applied during enter. Sets transition-property: width, duration 0.5s.
Applied during leave. Sets transition-property: width, duration 0.5s.
Applied to elements repositioning in a group transition. Sets transition-property: transform, duration 0.5s.

anatomy.svgDesc: Schematic showing width expansion from 0 to natural size on enter, and collapse on leave.
anatomy.figcaption: Anatomy of <origam-expand-x> — wraps a single element. JS hooks read offsetWidth to animate width from 0 → natural size on enter ①, and back to 0 on leave ②. overflow: hidden is set during the transition to prevent content overflow.

entry.name: ExpansionPanel
entry.description_fallback: Collapsible panel with animated header and content reveal. Supports accordion, popout and inset layout modes; optional loader, ripple and density controls.

notes.noteFallback: The header button carries aria-expanded="true|false" reflecting the current panel state. Screen readers announce the expanded/collapsed status.
The header button carries aria-controls pointing to the content region ID. The content region carries aria-labelledby pointing to the header ID.
Disabled panels use tabindex="-1" on the header and add aria-disabled via the disabled HTML attribute.
The expand/collapse animation respects prefers-reduced-motion: the transition-duration is overridden to 0ms.

keyboard.actionFallback: Toggles the panel expanded/collapsed when focus is on the header button.
Moves focus to the next interactive element (next header or content).

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Header minimum height when panel is expanded.

notes.noteFallback: The container manages group selection state and propagates it to child panels via inject/provide. Each panel header receives aria-expanded and aria-controls independently.
Visual props (density, color, bgColor, rounded, border) are cascaded via OrigamDefaultsProvider so all child panels share the same visual treatment without per-panel repetition.

entry.name: Fade
entry.description_fallback: Opacity-only enter/leave CSS transition. A thin wrapper around the generic Transition that sets name="origam-transition--fade".

notes.noteFallback: useCssTransition automatically sets disabled=true when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is detected. Content appears/disappears instantly with no opacity animation.
The transition wrapper adds no elements to the DOM — it is transparent to the accessibility tree. Only the slotted content is announced by screen readers.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Easing applied to the opacity transition: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

entry.name: Field
entry.description_fallback: Shared form-field shell used by all input components (TextField, NumberField, PasswordField…). Provides the label, prefix/suffix, prepend/append-inner zones, loader, outline/underline rendering and error state. Not intended for direct use — consume through a specific input component.

notes.noteFallback: The floating label is wired to the input via the id passed through the default slot props. Consumers must bind the id from slotProps to their <input> id attribute.
The aria-describedby attribute is provided through the default slot props and must be forwarded to the native <input> so screen readers read associated messages.
When error is truthy, the --error modifier class is applied. Consumers are responsible for adding aria-invalid="true" to the native input.
The required prop appends * to the label. The native required attribute must be added to the <input> element directly by the consuming component.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus to the embedded input element (passed via #default slot).
Clears the field when clearable=true and focus is inside the field.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Border opacity at rest (translucent on inactive state).
Block padding for size=default (36px control). Centres input text vertically.

entry.name: FileField
entry.description_fallback: File upload input with three display modes (list, chips, counter), an optional drag-and-drop dropzone, file size validation, progress tracking and per-item download/remove actions.

notes.noteFallback: The dropzone is a <label> element pointing to the hidden <input type="file">. Clicking anywhere on the label opens the native file picker.
Drag events (dragenter, dragover, dragleave, drop) are handled on the <label>. The --dragging modifier class provides visual feedback during dragover.
When disabled=true, the hidden input is disabled and cursor changes to not-allowed. The dropzone opacity drops to 0.6.

    v-model="files"
    label="Attachments"
    multiple
    chips
    show-size

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const files = ref([])
</script>

entry.name: Form
entry.description_fallback: Form container with centralised validation, global error messaging, accessible submit/reset lifecycle, and an optional scroll-to-first-error behaviour. Wraps any number of Origam input fields and coordinates their validation state.

notes.noteFallback: The form element uses novalidate to suppress browser-native validation bubbles. All validation is handled by Origam components and displayed in field detail zones.
Form-level messages appear in the __details section via OrigamMessages which carries aria-live="polite" internally. Screen readers announce errors after submit.

scrollToError (prop) and scrollToFirstError (exposed method) move focus to the first errored field after validation. This is an important accessibility improvement for long forms — screen readers naturally encounter the error context without manual navigation.
Setting disabled=true injects IFormProvide.isDisabled = true into all descendant fields via provide/inject. No need to set disabled individually on each field.

keyboard.actionFallback: Submits the form when focus is on a [type=submit] button inside the form.
No built-in behaviour — consumers may bind Escape to call reset() or navigate away.

import { ref } from 'vue'
const isValid = ref(null)

<template>
  <origam-form
    :error-messages="serverErrors"
    @submit.prevent="handleSubmit"
  >
    <origam-text-field v-model="username" label="Username" />
    <template #actions="{ submit }">
      <origam-btn text="Login" @click="submit" />
    </template>
  </origam-form>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
const username = ref('')
const serverErrors = ref([])
const handleSubmit = async () => {
  const res = await login(username.value)
  if (!res.ok) serverErrors.value = [res.message]
}

entry.name: Grid
entry.description_fallback: Declarative CSS Grid container. Exposes every CSS grid property through typed Vue props — no JS track measurement, no fallback to flexbox. columns, rows, gap, areas, autoFlow and alignment props map directly to the corresponding CSS grid properties.

notes.noteFallback: The tag prop defaults to "div" — change it to a semantic element when the grid represents a meaningful structure (e.g. tag="ul" with list items, tag="section" for a named region).

CSS Grid visual reordering (via order or explicit grid-row/column placement) can diverge from DOM order. Keyboard navigation follows DOM order — avoid visual arrangements that confuse users navigating by Tab.

entry.name: Img
entry.description_fallback: Responsive image component with lazy loading, aspect-ratio enforcement, placeholder and error slot, optional gradient overlay, srcset / sizes support, and a smooth fade-in transition on load.

notes.noteFallback: Always provide a meaningful alt text. When alt is present, role="img" and aria-label={alt} are set on the root. For decorative images, omit alt and set aria-hidden="true" on the parent.

Lazy loading is handled via IntersectionObserver (not the native loading="lazy" attribute) so the component loads the image only when it enters the viewport. The placeholder slot is announced by the browser as the alt text is still present on the root.
When the image fails to load, the #error slot is shown. The slot content should include meaningful text or an icon-with-label so users know the image did not load.
The fade-in transition respects prefers-reduced-motion. When the user prefers reduced motion, set transition="false" or use --origam-img---transition-duration: 0ms.

entry.name: ItemGroup
entry.description_fallback: Renderless selection container that tracks which child OrigamItem elements are selected. Single, multiple and mandatory selection modes.

notes.noteFallback: OrigamItemGroup is renderless and carries no ARIA role itself. Consumers must ensure the rendered children have appropriate roles (button, tab, radio, etc.).

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus through the child items. Keyboard navigation is delegated to the rendered child elements (e.g. origam-btn with role="button").

tokens.pipelineNote: OrigamItemGroup has no component-level CSS custom properties. Visual styling is fully delegated to child elements.

entry.name: Lazy
entry.description_fallback: Defers the mounting of its children until the placeholder enters the viewport. Uses IntersectionObserver (v-intersect directive) with an optional fade-in transition.

notes.noteFallback: While the content is not yet revealed, the root element carries aria-busy="true". This signals to assistive technologies that the region is still loading.

OrigamLazy relies on IntersectionObserver. Ensure placeholder dimensions are set (min-height / height) so the browser can observe a non-zero element. A zero-size element may never intersect and the content would never mount.
The default OrigamFade transition respects prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — pass transition="null" to fully disable animation.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Duration of the reveal fade-in transition.
Default minimum height for the placeholder zone.
Background color of the empty placeholder zone.

legend.descriptionFallback: Root element. Renders as <div> by default, <a> when href/to is set. Grid container: 3 columns (prepend / content / append).
Leading icon/avatar zone. grid-area: prepend. Renders prependIcon, prependAvatar, or the #prepend slot. v-if="hasPrepend".
grid-area: content. Contains title, subtitle and the #default slot.
Primary text. Truncates with ellipsis (white-space: nowrap). v-if="hasTitle".
Secondary text. Uses -webkit-box clamp via the lines prop. v-if="hasSubtitle".
Trailing icon/avatar zone. grid-area: append. Renders appendIcon, appendAvatar, or the #append slot. v-if="hasAppend".
Absolute interaction scrim. opacity: 0 at rest → 0.08 on hover/focus → 0.12 when active. Only rendered when the item is clickable or active.

legend.descriptionFallback: Root <main>. Applies padding-inline-start/end/block-start/end from layout offset CSS vars (--origam-layout---position-*). flex: 1 0 auto by default.
Inner wrapper. In scrollable mode the class becomes __scroller and adds overflow-y: auto; flex: 1 1 auto. Layout offsets are reset to 0 inside the scroller so nested layout items don't double-count.

classes.descriptionFallback: Root element (defaults to <main>). Reads layout position offset CSS vars for automatic padding.
Applied when scrollable=true. Switches to position: absolute, display: flex.
Inner wrapper. Hosts the default slot.
Additional class on __wrapper in scrollable mode. overflow-y: auto; flex: 1 1 auto. Resets layout offset vars to 0.

entry.name: Masonry
entry.description_fallback: Pinterest-style masonry grid. Uses native CSS grid-template-rows: masonry when supported; falls back to a ResizeObserver bucket-fill algorithm. Container-query responsive via columnBreakpoints.

notes.noteFallback: OrigamMasonry renders with role="list". In the JS path, each item wrapper carries role="listitem". In the CSS path, direct children should carry their own semantic markup.
Items are laid out in DOM order. Visual column order may differ from reading order — ensure the DOM order matches a meaningful reading sequence for keyboard and screen reader users.
Transitions are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce via a dedicated @media block in the SCSS.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Duration of the animated position-change transition.
Easing of the animated position-change transition.

tokens.pipelineNote: Built with Style Dictionary v4 + @tokens-studio/sd-transforms. The token file is minimal — most visual configuration is expressed as CSS vars injected inline by the component.

legend.descriptionFallback: CSS path: display: grid; grid-template-rows: masonry; align-tracks: start. grid-template-columns set via --origam-masonry---template-columns CSS var. No item wrappers — children are direct grid items.
JS fallback path: position: relative; display: block. Container height driven by --origam-masonry---container-height. Items absolutely positioned.
In the CSS path, children are placed directly as grid items. No wrapper is injected by the component.
In the JS fallback path, each child VNode is wrapped in a div.origam-masonry__item with position: absolute; left/top/width computed by useMasonry.

classes.descriptionFallback: Root element. role="list". Box-sizing: border-box; gap driven by --origam-masonry---resolved-gap.
CSS path modifier. display: grid; grid-template-rows: masonry; align-tracks: start.
JS fallback modifier. position: relative; display: block; height from --origam-masonry---container-height.
Applied when animated=true. Adds CSS transitions on item position changes.
Absolute-positioned wrapper for each child VNode in the JS fallback path. role="listitem".

cssVars.descriptionFallback: Bridge variable: the serialised gap value (token or raw CSS). Consumed by the gap property AND read back by the JS algo via getComputedStyle.

cssVars.name: --origam-masonry---template-columns
cssVars.descriptionFallback: CSS path only. Set to repeat(N, 1fr) where N = active column count.

cssVars.name: --origam-masonry---container-height
cssVars.descriptionFallback: JS path only. Set to the computed total height of the bucket-fill layout.

cssVars.name: --origam-masonry---animation-duration
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Duration of position-change transitions (animated=true).

cssVars.name: --origam-masonry---animation-easing
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Easing of position-change transitions.

exposed.descriptionFallback: Utility to forward a filtered subset of props to a child.

exposed.name: layout
exposed.type: Ref<{ items: Array<{ left: number; top: number; width: number }>; containerHeight: number }>
exposed.descriptionFallback: Reactive layout data computed by useMasonry. Available in both paths but only consumed by the template in the JS path.

exposed.name: relayout
exposed.descriptionFallback: Forces an immediate re-computation of the bucket-fill layout. Useful after programmatically changing item content without changing the DOM structure.

exposed.name: useCssPath
exposed.descriptionFallback: True when the CSS masonry path is active. False when the JS fallback runs.

exposed.name: gapPx
exposed.descriptionFallback: Current gap value in pixels as resolved by getComputedStyle. Used by the JS bucket-fill algorithm.

props.name: columns
props.description_fallback: Default number of columns when no columnBreakpoints entry matches the container width. Must be a positive integer ≥ 1.

props.name: columnBreakpoints
props.description_fallback: Map of min-width (px) → column count. Based on container width (not viewport) via ResizeObserver. Example: { 600: 2, 900: 3, 1200: 4 }.

props.name: gap
props.description_fallback: Gap between items. Accepts a token size key (xs | sm | md | lg | xl), a CSS length string, or a number (→ px). Defaults to md.

props.name: animated
props.description_fallback: Animates item position changes (transform, top, left, width) when the column count changes. Uses CSS transition — disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: align
props.description_fallback: Vertical alignment of items. "top" (standard Pinterest layout) | "center". Only the JS fallback honours "center" — the CSS path always packs to the top.

props.name: height
props.description_fallback: Fixed height of the masonry container.

props.name: width
props.description_fallback: Fixed width of the masonry container.

props.name: bgColor
props.description_fallback: Background color of the masonry container.

props.name: color
props.description_fallback: Foreground color inherited by children.

props.name: elevation
props.description_fallback: Box-shadow elevation token.

props.name: rounded
props.description_fallback: Border-radius token or boolean.

props.name: border
props.description_fallback: Applies a border to the container.

props.name: tag
props.description_fallback: Root HTML element tag.

slots.description_fallback: Children to layout in the masonry grid. Each direct child is treated as a masonry item. In the JS fallback path, each child is wrapped in a div.origam-masonry__item with absolute positioning.

examples.code:
<template>
  <origam-masonry :columns="3" gap="md">
    <origam-card
      v-for="photo in photos"
      :key="photo.id"
      :image="photo.src"
      :height="photo.height"
    />
  </origam-masonry>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
const photos = [
  { id: 1, src: '/img/a.jpg', height: 200 },
  { id: 2, src: '/img/b.jpg', height: 320 },
  { id: 3, src: '/img/c.jpg', height: 160 },
  { id: 4, src: '/img/d.jpg', height: 260 }
]
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Adapts column count based on the container width, not viewport -->
  <origam-masonry
    :columns="1"
    :column-breakpoints="{ 480: 2, 768: 3, 1024: 4 }"
    gap="lg"
  >
    <MyCard v-for="item in items" :key="item.id" v-bind="item" />
  </origam-masonry>
</template>

<template>
  <!-- Disable position-change animation for users preferring reduced motion -->
  <origam-masonry :animated="false" :columns="2">
    <slot />
  </origam-masonry>
</template>

relations.description_fallback: Uniform grid layout — use Grids for equal-height cards, Masonry for variable-height items.
For very large masonry lists, combine with VirtualScroll to render only visible rows.

entry.name: Media
entry.description_fallback: Universal media controls shell (controller, scrubber, volume) consumed by OrigamAudio and OrigamVideo. Headless and media-agnostic — drives any HTMLMediaElement via state + methods refs from useMediaPlayer().

notes.noteFallback: OrigamMediaScrubber sets role="slider", aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext on the track element. Keyboard users can seek using ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.
OrigamMediaVolumeControl mute button receives an aria-label from the muteLabel / unmuteLabel props. These must be translated strings passed by the parent.
Scrubber transitions and controller fade-in are suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

keyboard.actionFallback: Toggle play / pause.
Seek backward (scrubber step or 5 s).
Seek forward (scrubber step or 5 s).
Adjust volume (vertical scrubber when focused).
Toggle mute.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Fill color of the scrubber progress bar and thumb.
Border-radius of the track, progress and thumb (pill by default).

entry.name: MediaController
entry.description_fallback: Universal media controls shell shared by OrigamAudio and OrigamVideo. Purely presentational — receives state and methods from useMediaPlayer() and emits playback intents (play, pause, seek, volume, loop, shuffle, quality, download) without owning the HTMLMediaElement.

notes.noteFallback: The transport row is a <nav> element with aria-label set via the i18n key "origam.media.transport". This correctly marks the zone as a landmark region.
Toggle buttons (shuffle, loop, cast) use aria-pressed reflecting their active state. Screen readers announce "pressed" or "not pressed" on focus.

All icon-only buttons carry an aria-label (play, pause, previous, next, mute, unmute, shuffle, loop-all/one/off, cast, stop-cast, settings). Labels are i18n-translated strings computed in the script, not hardcoded strings in the template.
The inner OrigamMediaScrubber uses role="slider", aria-orientation="horizontal", aria-valuemin/max/now/text and aria-label. See MediaScrubber accessibility notes for the full keyboard matrix.

legend.descriptionFallback: Root div. display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0. When inset=true, applies .origam-media-controller--inset (position: absolute, dark gradient overlay, opacity: 0 by default). .origam-media-controller--visible toggles opacity: 1 and pointer-events: auto.
Optional header region above the scrubber. OrigamAudio injects cover art + metadata strip here.
Scrubber row — padding: 0 12px. Contains OrigamMediaScrubber by default; replaceable via the #waveform slot.
Left transport group: previous, play/pause, next, volume control, time display. Flex row; gap: 2px. Buttons use variant="text" density="compact".
Right transport group: shuffle, loop, cast, config cog menu. Same sizing as the left group.
Optional footer region below the transport row. OrigamAudio injects the playlist here.

classes.descriptionFallback: Root flex column.
Applied when inset=true. position: absolute; bottom/left/right: 0; dark gradient; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none.
Combined with --inset to show the overlay: opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto.
Scrubber container with inline padding.
Transport row. display: flex; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 36px.
Left button group: flex row; gap: 2px.
Right button group: flex row; gap: 2px.
Class applied to the inner OrigamMediaScrubber. width: 100%; overrides scrubber color tokens.
Time display: currentTime / duration. Inline-flex; monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

props.name: state
props.description_fallback: Reactive media state from useMediaPlayer() (or a specialisation: useVideoPlayer, useAudioPlayer). Contains refs for playing, currentTime, duration, volume, muted, buffered, playbackRate, remoteAvailable, remoteState.

props.name: methods
props.description_fallback: Imperative methods from useMediaPlayer(). Provides play(), pause(), seek(), setVolume(), toggleMute(), setPlaybackRate(), requestRemotePlayback().

props.name: inset
props.description_fallback: YouTube-style overlay mode: the shell sits on top of the media surface with a dark gradient and auto-hides on visible=false. When false, renders as a regular always-on toolbar.

entry.name: MediaScrubber
entry.description_fallback: Headless media-agnostic track-and-thumb slider widget. Owns the full pointer-events drag pipeline, keyboard matrix (ARIA slider pattern), optional buffer bar, hover tooltip and both horizontal and vertical orientations. Used internally by OrigamMediaController for the timeline and the volume slider.

notes.noteFallback: role="slider" is set only when not disabled. When disabled, the role attribute is omitted (undefined) and tabindex becomes -1 so AT users are not invited to interact with a frozen widget.
ariaLabel is a required prop. Always pass a translated string (e.g. "Seek" for the timeline, "Volume" for the volume slider). The label must describe the purpose of the slider, not its current value.
Use ariaValueText for a human-readable representation of the value — e.g. "1:23" for a timestamp so screen readers announce "1 minute 23 seconds" rather than the raw float "83.4".
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, both track and thumb CSS transitions are disabled (transition: none).
The component uses setPointerCapture() on pointerdown so drag events continue even when the pointer leaves the element boundary. This is the standard drag pattern for range inputs on touch devices.

keyboard.actionFallback: Increases the value by step (or 5% of range when step=0). ArrowRight for horizontal; ArrowUp for vertical.
Decreases the value by step (or 5% of range when step=0). ArrowLeft for horizontal; ArrowDown for vertical.
Increases the value by 10% of the range (same regardless of step).
Decreases the value by 10% of the range.
Sets the value to min.
Sets the value to max.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Track height on hover / focus / scrubbing.

legend.descriptionFallback: Root div. role="slider" (or undefined when disabled), tabindex="0" (or -1 when disabled), aria-orientation, aria-valuemin/max/now/text, aria-label. Handles all pointer and keyboard events. position: relative; cursor: pointer; touch-action: none; user-select: none.
Track bar. Background color from token --origam-media-scrubber---track-bg. Height grows from --track-thickness to --track-thickness-active on hover / focus / scrubbing. aria-hidden="true".
Buffered portion bar. Renders from min to buffered%. Background --origam-media-scrubber---buffer-bg. Visible only when buffered prop is a finite number. aria-hidden="true".
Playback progress bar. Width/height = valuePct%. Background --origam-media-scrubber---primary. aria-hidden="true".

Circular drag handle. Position driven by valuePct% (left in horizontal, bottom in vertical). Hidden at rest when showThumbOnHoverOnly=true; revealed on :hover, :focus-visible and .origam-media-scrubber--scrubbing. aria-hidden="true".
Hover tooltip. position: absolute; bottom: calc(100% + 8px); left = hoverPct%. Contains the #tooltip slot or the formatted value string. Horizontal orientation only. aria-hidden="true".

Applied when orientation="vertical". height: 100%; width: 14px; flex-direction: column.
Applied when disabled=true. cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5.
Applied while a pointer drag is in progress. Prevents pointerleave from clearing the tooltip.
Applied when showThumbOnHoverOnly=true. Scales the thumb to 0 at rest.
Track bar — background + growing height on hover.
Buffered portion indicator bar.
Playback progress fill.
Circular drag handle (position: absolute).
Floating hover value tooltip (horizontal only).

cssVars.name: --origam-media-scrubber---color
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Primary accent color. Drives --origam-media-scrubber---primary (progress bar + thumb fill).

cssVars.name: --origam-media-scrubber---track-background-color
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Idle track fill. Semi-transparent by design (overlaid on the media surface).

cssVars.name: --origam-media-scrubber---buffer-background-color
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Buffer bar fill. Slightly more opaque than the track.

cssVars.name: --origam-media-scrubber---thumb-diameter
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Diameter of the circular thumb handle.

cssVars.name: --origam-media-scrubber---track-size
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Track thickness at rest.

cssVars.name: --origam-media-scrubber---track-size-active
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Track thickness on hover / focus / scrubbing. Animates over 140ms.

cssVars.name: --origam-media-scrubber__tooltip---background-color
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Hover tooltip background. Near-black for contrast.

cssVars.name: --origam-media-scrubber__tooltip---color
cssVars.descriptionFallback: Hover tooltip text color.

exposed.name: rootEl
exposed.descriptionFallback: Template ref to the root DOM element. Useful for measuring the track dimensions or programming pointer capture externally.

exposed.name: isScrubbing
exposed.descriptionFallback: True while a pointer drag is captured. The parent can use this to suppress autohide logic on the controller overlay during a drag.

exposed.name: hoverValue
exposed.descriptionFallback: The hovered track value while the cursor is over the scrubber. null when the cursor has left. Mirrors the hover emit.

props.name: modelValue
props.description_fallback: Current value between min and max. Supports v-model. The component never mutates this directly — every change surfaces via update:modelValue.

props.name: max
props.description_fallback: Upper bound of the value range. Required to compute the thumb position. Passing 0 or any value <= min freezes the scrubber at the start.

props.name: min
props.description_fallback: Lower bound of the value range.

props.name: step
props.description_fallback: Discrete step. 0 (default) means continuous — pointer events emit the raw float; positive values snap each emission to the nearest multiple.

props.name: buffered
props.description_fallback: Optional buffered position (end of the browser's media buffer). Renders the __buffer bar from min up to buffered. Pass undefined to hide the bar entirely.

props.name: orientation
props.description_fallback: Layout axis. horizontal = YouTube timeline shape; vertical = volume / level meter shape (top of track = max, bottom = min).

props.name: disabled
props.description_fallback: Disables pointer + keyboard interaction. The element drops out of the tab order (tabindex="-1") and pointer events become no-ops.

props.name: showThumbOnHoverOnly
props.description_fallback: Hides the thumb at rest and reveals it on hover / focus / drag — the YouTube pattern. When false, the thumb is always visible.

props.name: showHoverTooltip
props.description_fallback: Shows a tooltip above the cursor (horizontal only) reflecting the hovered value. Content can be overridden via the #tooltip slot.

props.name: formatHoverTooltip

emits.description_fallback: Live value update — fires during drag, keyboard and click. The parent should update modelValue immediately for smooth thumb tracking.

Fired when the drag ends (pointerup or pointercancel).

slots.description_fallback: Hover-tooltip body. Receives the hovered value. Only rendered when showHoverTooltip=true and orientation="horizontal" and the cursor sits over the track.

Increment and decrement buttons have aria-label="Increment" and aria-label="Decrement" respectively. They also have aria-hidden="true" on their icon children.
When value reaches min or max, the corresponding button is disabled (pointer-events: none, aria-disabled="true").

keyboard.actionFallback: Increments the value by step.
Decrements the value by step.
Moves focus to the next interactive element (input → increment → decrement).

entry.name: OverlayScrim
entry.description_fallback: Full-viewport backdrop that dims content behind a dialog, drawer or menu. Supports click-to-close and custom background color.

notes.noteFallback: The scrim element always carries aria-hidden="true" — it is purely decorative. Screen readers skip it entirely.
Click events are forwarded to the parent overlay which is responsible for closing and restoring focus.

keyboard.actionFallback: Conventionally closes the parent overlay (handled by the parent, not the scrim itself).

<!-- OrigamTransition wraps for enter/leave animation -->
<origam-transition :transition="transition">
  <div
    v-if="active"
    class="origam-scrim"
    aria-hidden="true"
    @click="emit('click', $event)"
    @mouseenter="emit('mouseenter', $event)"
    @mouseleave="emit('mouseleave', $event)"
  />
</origam-transition>

entry.name: ParallaxLayer
entry.description_fallback: Depth layer inside a Parallax container. Each layer registers a speed multiplier with the parent and is driven frame-by-frame via a rAF loop (JS path) or CSS scroll-driven animations (CSS path).

notes.noteFallback: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the CSS keyframe animation and the rAF loop are both disabled. The layer is rendered at its static offset (offsetX, offsetY) without any movement.
ParallaxLayer is a purely presentational layer. All semantic content must come from the slotted markup.

    :is="tag"
    ref="layerRef"

legend.descriptionFallback: Parent OrigamParallax providing the injection context. Owns the scroll/mouse listeners and the rAF loop. Layers register on mount and unregister on unmount.
Background layer (speed < 1). Positioned absolute; inset: 0. Moves slower than the scroll — creates the depth illusion.
Neutral layer (speed = 1). Moves with the scroll. When the CSS scroll-driven path is active, carries .origam-parallax__layer--css-driven.

Foreground layer (speed > 1). Moves faster than the scroll. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, carries .origam-parallax__layer--reduced-motion and transform is locked to translate3d(offsetX, offsetY, 0).

classes.descriptionFallback: Root BEM element. position: absolute; inset: 0. will-change: transform. transform-origin: center center.
Present when animation-timeline: scroll() is supported. Enables the CSS scroll-driven animation keyframe instead of the JS rAF path.
Present under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Locks transform to the static offset (no movement).

props.name: speed
props.description_fallback: Parallax speed multiplier: 0 = fixed, 0.5 = half scroll speed (far background), 1 = neutral, >1 = faster than scroll (foreground). Negative values reverse the direction.

props.name: offsetX
props.description_fallback: Static horizontal offset in px applied on top of the parallax translation. Useful to nudge a layer without changing its speed.

entry.name: PasswordField
entry.description_fallback: Secure password input with show/hide toggle, 4-segment strength bar, and a requirements checklist (list or tile layout). Automatically injects validation rules for enabled requirements.

notes.noteFallback: The show/hide toggle is a button element with aria-label that changes between "Show password" and "Hide password" depending on state.
The requirements popup opens with aria-haspopup="listbox" on the input. Each requirement item announces its state via a visually-hidden text or the icon's aria-hidden.
The strength bar is visual only (aria-hidden). Strength feedback is conveyed via the requirements checklist and the update:strength emit, which the parent can use to show a text label.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus to the next interactive element (input → toggle icon).
Reveals or hides the password.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Input opacity transition for show/hide animation.
Glyph icon font-size — intentionally larger than standard token.

props.description_fallback: Positions the progress bar absolutely relative to its nearest positioned ancestor.

props.description_fallback: Adds animated diagonal stripes to the progress bar (linear only).

props.name: bufferValue
props.description_fallback: Linear only. Buffer value (e.g. media buffered percentage). Renders a secondary track from 0 to bufferValue.

props.name: clickable
props.description_fallback: Linear only. Makes the bar interactive — click sets modelValue to the clicked position. Used internally by OrigamMediaController.

props.name: reverse
props.description_fallback: Linear only. Reverses the bar direction (fills right to left).

props.name: stream
props.description_fallback: Linear only. Adds a streaming dots animation ahead of the progress bar (live media pattern).

props.name: location
props.description_fallback: Linear only. Absolute position on the screen when absolute=true: top | bottom.

props.name: rounded
props.description_fallback: Linear only. Border-radius of the bar ends. true → {radius.full}.

props.name: rotate

props.name: size
props.description_fallback: Circular only. Overall size of the spinner. Accepts size tokens (xs → xl) or a px number.

emits.description_fallback: Linear only, clickable=true. Fired when the user clicks the bar — payload is the new value (0 to max).

entry.name: QrCode
entry.description_fallback: SSR-safe SVG QR code renderer with configurable error correction level, quiet zone, module corner radius, optional title, and a centred icon/image overlay. Accepts any text or URL via the value prop.

notes.noteFallback: The root element has role="img" and aria-label. When ariaLabel is not set, it falls back to "QR code for {value}". This ensures screen readers announce the purpose without exposing the raw URL twice.
The center overlay (icon, image, or #center slot) is marked aria-hidden="true" since it is purely decorative — the aria-label on the root already conveys the full meaning.
When using a logo overlay, use errorCorrectionLevel="H" (30% redundancy). Lower levels may make the code unscannable when modules are occluded by the overlay.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Default module corner radius (square). Set via qrCodeProps.rounded.

tokens.pipelineNote: Built with Style Dictionary v4 + @tokens-studio/sd-transforms. Module color and corner-radius are applied at SVG generation time via resolveQrColor / resolveQrCornerRadius utilities.

notes.noteFallback: The underlying <input type="radio"> provides native radio behaviour: keyboard navigation, grouping via name, and correct role="radio" without any ARIA additions.
The label is associated with the input via <label> — clicking the label text activates the radio.
When disabled=true, the native disabled attribute is set on the input. No aria-disabled is needed.
Error state applies visual styling only. Connect an aria-describedby to an error message element for full accessibility.

anatomy.code:
<!-- RadioBtn delegates to SelectionControl with type="radio" -->
<origam-selection-control
  class="origam-radio-btn"
  v-model="model"
  type="radio"
  :true-icon="trueIcon"
  :false-icon="falseIcon"
  v-bind="controlProps"
  @click:label="handleClickLabel"
>
  <template #default><slot name="default" /></template>
  <template #input="{ props, icon, model }">
    <slot name="input" v-bind="{ props, icon, model }" />
  </template>
  <template #label><slot name="label" /></template>
</origam-selection-control>

anatomy.code:
<origam-input class="origam-radio-group">
  <template #default="{ id, messagesId, isDisabled, isReadonly }">
    <!-- optional group label -->
    <origam-label :id="id" :text="label" :required="required" />

    <!-- DefaultsProvider pushes color/density/size to children -->
    <origam-defaults-provider :defaults="radioDefaults">
      <origam-selection-control-group
        v-model="model"
        :id="id"
        :items="items"
        :multiple="false"
        :disabled="isDisabled"
        :readonly="isReadonly"
        :aria-labelledby="label ? id : undefined"
        :aria-describedby="messagesId"
      >
        <template #item="{ item }">
          <!-- #item slot or default OrigamRadio -->
          <origam-radio v-model="model" v-bind="item" />
        </template>
      </origam-selection-control-group>
    </origam-defaults-provider>
  </template>
</origam-input>

entry.name: RichToolbar
entry.description_fallback: Rich-text formatting toolbar with configurable command buttons (bold, italic, underline, link, lists, headings, code). Internal sub-component of OrigamTextareaField.

notes.noteFallback: The root <div> has role="toolbar" and aria-label (localised via t()). This groups the controls semantically for screen readers.
Each command button carries aria-pressed="true|false" reflecting the active state at the caret. Screen readers announce the toggle state.
When disabled=true, the toolbar root gets aria-disabled="true" and each button gets the disabled attribute.
@mousedown.prevent on every button prevents the contenteditable editor from losing focus when a format button is clicked.
The link button carries aria-expanded="true|false" to signal the popover state. The popover input is auto-focused on open (nextTick).

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus through command buttons. Each button is individually focusable.
Activates the focused command button and fires the format event.
Confirms the URL in the link popover input.
Closes the link popover without applying.

entry.name: ScaleRotate
entry.description_fallback: CSS-driven Vue transition that combines scale(0) + rotate(−45deg) + opacity on enter, with a symmetric leave. Sub-component of the Transition family.

notes.noteFallback: The transition is disabled automatically when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is detected (disabled prop becomes true via useCssTransition).
The wrapper is transparent to the accessibility tree. Only the slotted child is announced by screen readers.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Default enter/leave duration shared by all transition sub-components.

entry.name: SelectionControl
entry.description_fallback: Base selection-control primitive used by Checkbox, Radio, Switch and similar inputs. Renders a ripple zone, a native input and a label with full ARIA support.

notes.noteFallback: A native <input type="checkbox|radio"> is always rendered (even when the input slot is customised). This ensures browser-native focus, keyboard handling and form participation.
aria-checked is set automatically by the native input. For type="checkbox", aria-checked is forwarded explicitly via the :aria-checked binding.
The label is wired to the input via for/id. Clicking the label toggles the control and fires click:label.

When error=true, the label and icon adopt --origam-selection-control---color-error for visual feedback. No aria-invalid is set at this layer — use OrigamInput / form-level components for validation semantics.

Moves focus to the next interactive element.

entry.name: Sheet
entry.description_fallback: General-purpose surface container with optional swipe-to-expand bottom-sheet gesture. Used as the base layer for Dialog, Picker, ColorPickerField and other overlay components.

notes.noteFallback: The drag handle has role="button", tabindex="0" and aria-label="Drag handle" so keyboard users can navigate snap points without touch.
Under prefers-reduced-motion, the height transition is disabled. Height still changes imperatively but without animation.
OrigamSheet is a surface-only primitive. Overlay focus-trap and aria-modal semantics are managed by the Dialog or Drawer wrapper using this component.

entry.name: Skeleton
entry.description_fallback: Loading placeholder with animated pulse shimmer. Supports text, rectangular, circular, card and list-item variants. Renders real content via the default slot when loading=false.

notes.noteFallback: Each skeleton block has role="status", aria-busy="true" and aria-label="Loading". This ensures screen readers announce the loading state without repeating a full description.
The pulse animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. The skeleton remains visible as a static placeholder.
When loading=false, the skeleton is replaced by real content via the default slot. Ensure the revealed content is semantically correct (headings, alt text, etc.).

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Border-radius for text and rectangular variants.
