entry.name: Snackbar
entry.description_fallback: Temporary overlay that delivers brief non-blocking feedback at a configurable viewport location with optional auto-dismiss timer.

props.name: text
props.description_fallback: Body text displayed inside the snackbar. Can also be provided via the text slot.

props.name: multiLine
props.description_fallback: Increases the minimum height to accommodate multi-line message text.

props.name: vertical
props.description_fallback: Stacks the action buttons below the message text instead of inline.

props.name: timer
props.description_fallback: Displays a shrinking progress bar at the top of the snackbar showing the remaining timeout duration.

props.name: timeout
props.description_fallback: Auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds. Pass -1 to keep the snackbar open indefinitely.

props.name: location
props.description_fallback: Viewport anchor for the snackbar. Accepts compound values such as "bottom right".

props.name: color
props.description_fallback: Intent or custom foreground color applied to the snackbar surface.

props.name: bgColor
props.description_fallback: Background color override for the snackbar wrapper.

props.name: border
props.description_fallback: Applies a border to the snackbar wrapper. Defaults to true.

props.name: rounded
props.description_fallback: Border-radius token. Defaults to the theme default radius.

props.name: elevation
props.description_fallback: Box-shadow elevation token applied to the snackbar wrapper.

props.name: tag
props.description_fallback: HTML element rendered at the root.

props.name: transition
props.description_fallback: Transition used when the snackbar enters and exits. Defaults to the OrigamSnack slide-up transition.

emits.description_fallback: Fired when the snackbar open state changes. Bind with v-model.

slots.description_fallback: Custom content rendered inside the snackbar item body.
Custom icon or avatar placed before the message.
Bold title line rendered above the message.
Message body content. Alias: message slot.
Action area (buttons) rendered inside the snackbar. Receives isActive to allow dismissing programmatically.

examples.code:
<template>
  <origam-btn text="Show snackbar" @click="show = true" />
  <origam-snackbar v-model="show" text="File saved successfully." />
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const show = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <origam-snackbar v-model="open" status="success" text="Profile updated." />
  <origam-snackbar v-model="open" status="danger"  text="An error occurred." />
  <origam-snackbar v-model="open" status="warning" text="Session expires soon." />
  <origam-snackbar v-model="open" status="info"    text="New version available." />
</template>

<template>
  <origam-snackbar v-model="open" text="Item deleted.">
    <template #action="{ isActive }">
      <origam-btn variant="text" text="Undo" @click="isActive.value = false" />
    </template>
  </origam-snackbar>
</template>

props.description_fallback: Stacking order. Defaults to top-down for top-* locations and bottom-up for bottom-* locations.

entry.name: TextMask
entry.description_fallback: Renders text with a gradient or image as a transparent fill via background-clip: text. Supports animated gradients (pan, rotate, pulse, zoom).

notes.noteFallback: The text content is preserved in the DOM as plain text (or semantic slot content). The background-clip:text transform is purely CSS — screen readers and search engines read the real text.
All CSS animations are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. The background-size reverts to cover so the gradient is still visible.

Gradient backgrounds may produce low-contrast regions. Verify WCAG AA contrast ratios for the minimum-contrast point of the gradient. Add a fallback color for browsers that do not support background-clip:text.

entry.name: ThemeProvider
entry.description_fallback: Overrides the active theme and/or color mode for a sub-tree by setting data-theme and data-mode attributes on a display:contents wrapper.

notes.noteFallback: The root wrapper uses display:contents — it is invisible to the layout engine and does not create an extra stacking context or box. It should not affect the accessibility tree of its children.
When the sub-tree is a semantic region, use tag='section' or tag='article' to add semantic meaning to the wrapper instead of the invisible div default.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: ThemeProvider has no visible chrome — display:contents is its only CSS rule.

entry.name: Timeline
entry.description_fallback: Vertical or horizontal event timeline with dot, connector and item content slots. Supports alternating layout, custom intents per item, and scroll-snapping in horizontal mode.

notes.noteFallback: The root element has role="list". Each OrigamTimelineItem has role="listitem". Screen readers announce the number of items in the timeline.
Provide an ariaLabel prop to describe the timeline purpose (e.g. "Project history"). Without it, screen readers will not contextualise the list.
The track column (dot + connector) has aria-hidden="true" — it is decorative. Meaningful content lives in the content area.

keyboard.actionFallback: Moves focus between interactive elements inside the timeline items (links, buttons in content slots).

entry.name: Title
entry.description_fallback: Polymorphic heading with configurable tag (h1–h6 or any block element) and density-driven typography tokens.

notes.noteFallback: Always choose a tag value that fits the document heading hierarchy (h1 for the page title, h2 for sections, etc.). Skipping heading levels (h1 → h3) impairs screen reader navigation.
The vContrast directive automatically adjusts the text color for sufficient contrast against the background. Do not suppress it without verifying WCAG AA compliance manually.

When setting color or bgColor, verify that the contrast ratio meets WCAG 2.1 AA (≥ 4.5:1 for normal text). The vContrast directive assists but does not guarantee compliance for every color combination.

entry.name: Transition

entry.name: TreeviewNode
entry.description_fallback: Single node in a Treeview — renders chevron, icon, label and size badge; recursively renders children when expanded. Handles its own expand/select keyboard interactions.

notes.noteFallback: OrigamTreeviewNode uses a wrapper with role="none" and an inner interactive div with role="treeitem". ARIA attributes (aria-expanded, aria-selected, aria-disabled, aria-label) are applied to the inner row only.
The children container uses role="group" with aria-label="{node.label} contents" as required by the ARIA tree pattern.
Focus-visible outline is applied on the row via :focus-visible (2px solid, outline-offset: -2px).
Guide lines, chevron and icon are all aria-hidden="true". Only the label contributes to the accessible name (supplemented by aria-label="node.label" on the treeitem).

If expanded: collapses the node. If collapsed: moves focus to the parent treeitem.
Moves focus out of the tree to the next focusable element in the page.

entry.name: Video
entry.description_fallback: Full-featured HTML5 video player with custom controls, picture-in-picture, fullscreen, captions, playback rate, cast/AirPlay and double-tap-to-skip. All browser native events are surfaced as Vue emits.

notes.noteFallback: Subtitles/captions are provided via the tracks prop using WebVTT format. The captions button in the toolbar toggles the active track.
Autoplay is suppressed when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active, respecting the user preference.
The controls bar uses aria-label for icon-only buttons (play, mute, fullscreen). The scrubber is a range input with aria-label, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow.

keyboard.actionFallback: Toggle play/pause (when focus is on the player or controls).
Seek forward/backward by 5 seconds.
Increase/decrease volume by 10%.
Toggle mute.
Toggle fullscreen.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Size of the centered play button on the poster overlay.

props.name: src
props.description_fallback: Media URL or an array of IVideoSource descriptors (for multi-codec fallback). The browser picks the first decodable source.

props.description_fallback: Image shown before playback starts. Maps to the native poster attribute (or is used as background in the #poster slot).

props.name: tracks
props.description_fallback: Caption/subtitle/chapter tracks. Each entry maps to a <track> element with kind, src, srclang and label.

props.name: autoplay
props.description_fallback: Starts playback after loadedmetadata. Automatically sets muted=true (browser requirement). Suppressed when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.

props.name: muted
props.description_fallback: Starts the player muted. Required alongside autoplay for unattended playback.

props.name: loop
props.description_fallback: Restarts playback when the video ends.

props.name: controls
props.description_fallback: Control surface: custom (in-house toolbar), native (browser controls) or none (consumer drives via #controls slot or exposed methods).

props.name: playsInline
props.description_fallback: Maps to the native playsinline attribute. Required on iOS to prevent the system hijacking playback.

props.name: preload
props.description_fallback: Buffering hint. metadata loads just enough to compute duration; auto pre-buffers aggressively.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description_fallback: CSS aspect-ratio applied to the wrapper. Prevents layout shift after metadata loads. Accepts presets (16/9, 4/3, 1/1, 21/9) or any raw value.

props.name: inset
props.description_fallback: When true, the controls toolbar is overlaid on the video bottom edge and auto-hides during playback.

props.name: skipSeconds
props.description_fallback: Seconds skipped by the ±skip buttons and double-tap gesture. Pass 0 to hide skip buttons.

props.name: showCenterControls
props.description_fallback: Shows centered ±skip and play/pause overlay on hover and while paused.

props.name: playbackRates
props.description_fallback: Available playback rates exposed in the settings menu.

props.name: playbackRate
props.description_fallback: Initial playback rate (1 = normal). Synced via update:playbackRate.

props.name: disablePictureInPicture
props.description_fallback: Hides the PIP button and its keyboard shortcut.

props.name: allowRemotePlayback
props.description_fallback: Shows the cast/AirPlay button when the browser exposes the Remote Playback API and a device is available.

props.name: doubleTapToSkip
props.description_fallback: Double-tap left half = skip backward, right half = skip forward on touch devices.

Fired when the player enters fullscreen.
Fired when the player exits fullscreen.

Fired when picture-in-picture mode is exited.

entry.name: VirtualScroll
entry.description_fallback: Window-based virtual list renderer that only mounts visible rows, keeping the DOM small for arbitrarily large datasets. Supports both wrapper and renderless modes.

notes.noteFallback: Only visible items are in the DOM — screen readers may announce fewer items than the total count. Add aria-setsize and aria-posinset on each rendered item if the total count matters semantically.
When scrollToIndex is called programmatically, focus management is the consumer responsibility. Items outside the visible window are unmounted and cannot receive focus.

entry.name: VirtualScrollItem
entry.description_fallback: Per-item wrapper used by OrigamVirtualScroll — attaches a ResizeObserver to measure its height and emits update:height so the virtual engine can recalculate padding spacers.

notes.noteFallback: OrigamVirtualScrollItem has no ARIA role — it is a transparent measurement wrapper. ARIA semantics are entirely determined by the consuming content in the default/renderless slot.

In renderless mode the component renders no DOM element — the consumer's own element carries all semantic roles. This makes renderless mode the preferred approach for accessible list items (use a native <li> as the observed element).

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Default estimated item height used by the virtual engine for initial layout.
Easing for virtual scroll item transitions.

tokens.pipelineNote: Built with Style Dictionary v4 + @tokens-studio/sd-transforms. OrigamVirtualScrollItem has no intrinsic visual tokens; it inherits layout tokens from the parent virtual-scroll token group.

entry.name: Watermark
entry.description_fallback: Absolutely-positioned repeating diagonal overlay wrapping a content slot. Renders a tiled SVG data-URL with text or image glyph. Supports anti-tamper MutationObserver, pointer-events pass-through and full visual customisation.

notes.noteFallback: The overlay is purely visual. It carries aria-hidden="true" so screen readers skip it entirely — only the wrapped content is announced.
With pointerEvents="none" (default), all interactive elements inside the slot remain keyboard and pointer accessible.
The watermark is NOT a security feature. antiTamper adds dissuasion only — a determined user can always disable JS. Do not rely on it to protect sensitive data.

entry.name: Window
entry.description_fallback: Slide-based content switcher with previous/next navigation, touch swipe, keyboard support and configurable transitions. The base for Carousel, Stepper and Tab panels.

notes.noteFallback: Consider adding role="region" and aria-label to the window to make the slide region identifiable to screen readers.
Arrow buttons are OrigamBtn with icon props — always provide aria-label (e.g. "Previous slide", "Next slide") via the prevProps/nextProps slots.
For auto-advancing windows (e.g. carousel), add aria-live="polite" on the active slide container so screen readers announce the new content.

keyboard.actionFallback: Navigate to the previous/next slide when direction="horizontal".
Navigate to the previous/next slide when direction="vertical".
Moves focus through arrow buttons and content inside the active slide.

excerpt.descriptionFallback: Horizontal slide transition duration per item.
